text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ministerial committee for privatisation approves share offers in 12 companies and two joint venture banks. Prime Minister Ganzouri says privatisation programme moving successfully.
- Public Enterprise minister says Egypt has received offers from 650 investment bodies to buy stakes in public sector companies after new incentives law was issued to encourage direct investment.
- Head of investment authority tells al-Ahram that his organisation had approved by the end of June 5932 investment projects worth 121 billion pounds.
- Egyptian-Libyan committee urges financial officials from both sides to compare documents to prepare for settlement of financial differences.
- Mubarak urges officials to fight smoking.
- Moody's predicts improvement for rating of Egypt's economy.

- Capital Market Authority cancels some subscription on share offer which took place five months ago in Alexandria Commercial and Maritime Bank . Brokerage firms were surprised to find huge increase in number of shares on offer when sale opened.
- Intensive contacts between Egypt and the Palestinian Authority to assess Ross's visit.
